channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 38 new entries
item.description:
38 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, proteomics, histology / imaging-only, multi-omics, and 2 more.

Poly Pipeline
A bioinformatic pipeline for spatial transcriptomics analysis across polyploid and diploid plant/animal genomes.

resolVI
A probabilistic model correcting molecule misassignment and batch effects in spatial transcriptomics data.

OT-knn
An optimal transport method aligning spatial transcriptomics slices using local neighborhood context.

ProST
A multimodal deep learning framework combining histology images and expression for spatial domain identification.

SVGRN
A conditional VAE framework inferring spot-specific gene regulatory networks from spatial transcriptomics.

stEDGE
An edge-guided framework reconstructing hierarchical, multiscale spatial domains and transition interfaces from ST data.

mc-ASTRA
A Python framework mapping population-level tissue variation to interpretable multicellular organization programs.

FlowMap
Jointly models cell states and RNA velocity on a shared geometric manifold for coherent trajectories.

RamanOmics
Integrates hyperspectral Raman imaging with snRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to profile senescent cell states.

gsModel
Deep learning model classifies cortical gyri versus sulci from spatial transcriptomic cell-type composition.

CUBE
Multimodal encoder fuses H&E histology, multiplex IHC protein, and spatial transcriptomic data via attention-based bridging.

High-Dimensional Multi-Omic Mapping of Post-Mortem Human Brain Using Iterative Indirect Immunofluorescence Imaging on Xenium-Processed Tissues
Post-processing protocol adds iterative 4i immunofluorescence onto Xenium tissue for combined RNA-protein spatial mapping.

A platform for deep topographic multiomic mapping of the bone marrow environment in multiple myeloma
Combines LCM-based genomics, LC-MS/MS proteomics and spatial transcriptomics via digital co-registration of adjacent sections.

SpaMOAL
Graph contrastive learning method integrating spatial coordinates, histology and multi-omics profiles for spatial domain identification.

DePass
Dual-enhanced graph learning framework that denoises and integrates paired single-cell and spatial multi-omics data.

SpaHDSRL
Hierarchical dual-graph self-supervised learning framework integrating spatial and modality-specific graphs for multi-omics domain identification.

Spatial organization and mitigation of autofluorescence in multiplexed spatial proteomics of aged fresh-frozen human brain
Tris-EDTA photobleaching protocol plus 28-plex antibody panel for multiplexed spatial proteomics of fresh-frozen brain.

SpaCEy
Explainable graph neural network predicting clinical outcomes from spatial proteomics tissue graphs.

Spatial partitioning of cell and extracellular matrix in multiplexed fluorescence imaging of defined bone compartments in whole-femur cross-sections
QuPath-based pipeline quantifying cellular versus ECM protein signals across bone tissue compartments in multiplexed imaging.

MINT
Infers cell-resolved spatial transcriptomes from paired histology and spatial measurements without external reference.

Lectin-IMC
Multiplex lectin-based imaging mass cytometry panel visualizing spatial glycan-protein-cell relationships in tissue.

MCseg
No-code platform for cell segmentation and transcript assignment whose pipeline was designed via AI-agent search.

OmiCoreTumorDetector
Open CNN ensemble model mapping tumour regions in colorectal cancer H&E sections, exporting QuPath annotations.

FlashDeconv
Fast, deterministic cell-type deconvolution algorithm for million-bin spatial transcriptomics data.

Protocol for identifying cellular and molecular signatures from spatial profiling data using micro-tissue analysis
Protocol using partial least-squares modeling to find multivariate feature signatures in spatial profiling microenvironments.

Halo
Pretrained model reconstructing whole-cell boundaries from nuclei images and transcript density in spatial transcriptomics.

AINR
Implicit neural representation with attention maps spatial coordinates to gene expression for domain identification.

STCGCar
Graph contrastive learning framework with reliable augmentation for spatial domain clustering in spatial transcriptomics.

STAMGC
Dual-contrastive graph convolutional network that identifies spatial domains in spatial transcriptomics data.

SSMGCN
Multi-view graph convolutional network decoupling shared/specific spatial and expression information for spatial domain clustering.

Domain Elastic Transform
Grid-free Bayesian framework registering high-dimensional spatial transcriptomics functions without voxelization.

SpaOT
Semi-metric unbalanced optimal transport framework for integrating and aligning spatial multi-omics tissue data.

spaGFM
Graph foundation model pretrained on 43.9M cells to represent cellular neighborhoods across spatial technologies.

ITO-PET slide
Conductive ITO-PET slide enabling sequential MALDI-MSI and LCM-proteomics on the same tissue section.

CellDot
Optimal-transport framework reassigning or removing misassigned transcripts to decontaminate imaging-based spatial transcriptomics.

DiffGSP
Uses Fick's law and graph signal processing to reverse mRNA diffusion and recover true spatial expression.

SCIRA, GCSCAN, PathNet-TLS
Purpose-built tools for receptor-ligand quantification, TLS/germinal center delineation, and TLS detection on H&E.

A Real‐Data‐Driven Framework for Evaluating Differential Transcript Usage Methods Across Long‐Read Bulk, Single‐Cell, and Spatial Transcriptomics
Evaluates differential transcript usage methods using real data across bulk, single-cell and spatial long-read transcriptomics.
